The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.dst: Es el sector más importante del taller de Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: Busca el aparato por el taller de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: ¿Y seguro que no va a bajar aquí?
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: Eh... más o menos. Seguro al {~}. Hoy no debería pasar nada si nos damos prisa.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: Se acerca el festival, tiene mucho entre manos. Estará limpiando los otros talleres, construyendo los artilugios que necesite para el festival de este año... ese tipo de cosas.
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: Aquí abajo solo baja para los proyectos grandes. Bueno, o cuando necesita desahogarse. Pero hoy no tiene nada entre manos, así que... estamos a salvo.
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: ...si tú lo dices, Yusanu. Aun así, prefiero salir de aquí cuanto antes.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: Sí... yo también. Cojamos el aparato y vámonos.
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: Esta es la sala favorita de Soosu en el taller. Su sala de creación de gólems.
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: Ella... me dijo una vez que le gusta trabajar con plantas. Por eso muchos de sus gólems están hechos a partir de macetas y tierra.
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: Hm. Bueno, menos mal que usa su bendición en esto y no en... no sé. ¿Remodelar el mundo entero?
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#418.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#418.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: ¡Oh, eh, si es Flowers! ¡Es el gólem favorito de Soosu! Aunque no sé por qué duerme aquí y no en su Flowerscama. ... Ese nombre no lo puse yo.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: ¡¡¡Por fin!!! ¡¡¡Ha dicho que sí!!! ¡El tío T por fin me deja visitar su taller, qué ilusión!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: ¡¡Es de verdad!! ¡¡¡¡Flowers ya es DE VERDAD!!!! ¡¡Le enseñé mi dibujo a mamá y me ayudó a coserlo!! ¡Ahora hago juego con Fiona! Ella tiene a Daruma y yo tengo a... ¡Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: Hmpf. ¡Hmpf!!!!!!!! Fiona ya tiene edad y también trabaja... ¡¡¡¡siempre está cansada y ya no juega conmigo!!!! Es un asco. ¡¡¡¡Un asco!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: ¡¡El tío T va a ayudarme a hacer la súper ordeñadora automática!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: Grrrrrr............ ¡¡¡¡Llevo SIGLOS sin escribir......... y es porque tengo que TRABAJAR!!!! ¡¡¡¡En los CAMPOS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: ¡¡He estado LEYENDO!! Leyendo muchísimos libros... ¡sobre AGRICULTURA!
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: ¡¡Otra vez esa época del año!! ¡¡¡EL FESTIVAL DE LA CORONA!!! ¡¡¡Solo falta una semana!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.dst: Hoy pasó algo raro. ¡El tío T vino a casa con un hombre extraño del ejército, con un uniforme elegantísimo y todo!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: ¡¡Resulta que a la Corona le gustó mucho mi súper mega granjero!! Como facilita cosechar y esas cosas, quieren que hagamos más, ¡¡¡para que todos trabajen más rápido!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: Hoy el tío T se hizo mucho daño. Muchísimo, muchísimo daño.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#432.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#432.dst: Mamá dice que el tío T se pondrá bien. Se pondrá.
The Price of Ingenuity#432.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: ¡¡¡La Ciudadela fue INCREÍBLE!!! Siempre soñé con subir allí algún día... ¡¡y ya lo HE HECHO!!
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: El proyecto E-lec-tricidad sigue en marcha (sí, le cambiaron el nombre... al Soberano no le gustó el que le puse antes...... bah.), ¡¡y va genial!!
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: Al releer estas entradas, yo... me siento vacía.
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: Mamá murió de su enfermedad hace unos días. Parece que hacía tiempo que sabían que llegaría, pero... aun así fue un golpe.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: ¿Qué sentido tiene seguir escribiendo esto? No sé qué decir. Podría hablar de mis proyectos, de todos los avances que he hecho, pero todo se siente tan vacío.
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: ¿Cuántos años han pasado? Puedo mirar las fechas, pero... no quiero.
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: ¡No olvides nunca, no dejes nunca de crear, no cedas jamás!
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: Y ahí está... visto así, es realmente impresionante.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: Otra vez: ¿de verdad no sabes para qué sirve esto? Y más importante, ¿quién de nosotros lo llevará?
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: Yo diría que hasta que estemos a salvo lo lleve {u}. Y no... de verdad, no tengo ni idea. Cada vez que le he pedido a Soosu que me lo explique, me ha dado largas.
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#447.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#447.dst: Bueno. Sea lo que sea, no puede ser bueno si la Corona lo quiere. {u}, ¿vamos?
The Price of Ingenuity#447.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: No puede ser otra cosa - y son dos pares. Así que Soosu está aquí, pero ¿con quién...?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: ...¿seguro que es buena idea? Dividir tu atención entre la conversación y tus...proyectos... En el pasado no ha salido bien.
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: Pues, ya sabes, Zhiraok, no to-o-odo el mundo tiene tiempo de dejarlo todo y salir de su región. A veces tenemos un trabajo que hacer.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: ¡Ah, ahí estás, Flowers! Despierta, dormilón - ¡tienes que volver a hacer guardia!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: ¡Atención, Soosu! ¿Podrías avisar antes de pararte así?
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: ¿Hm? Ah, perdona, perdona, ¡pero toparse por sorpresa con un amigo íntimo es taaan agradable! Seguro que en tu cabeza hay hueco para eso, ¿hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: Soosu... ¡Ese problema ya está resuelto! ¿Cuántas veces te lo he dicho? ...Está bien, mira, eso es una tangente. Lo que de verdad tengo que decirte-
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: Escapa del taller sin que te vean.

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: ¿Soosu está aquí? ¡¿Y con Zhiraok, nada menos?! ¡Tenemos que salir, ya!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: ¡Sí, pero seguro que Flowers está en alerta máxima! ¡No uses tu magia y, pase lo que pase, que no te vean!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: Espera- ¿Qué, Flowers? ¡¿Intrusos?! ¡¿Al lado de la sala del aparato?!
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: ...!! ¡¡El Maldito!! ¡No le vas a poner un dedo encima, ¿me oyes?!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: ¿Pe-pero qué hélice- ¡Infiltrados! ¡Esta vez no os escapáis!
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: ¡¿Yusanu?! ¿Quién va contigo? Espera, ¡¿estáis intentando robar el aparato?!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: ¡Oye, que tenemos que correr! ¡¿Te lo estás tomando en serio siquiera?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: ...¡eres lo bastante lista como para que no tenga que repetirlo! ¡Sé que lo eres! ¡Por favor, tómate el problema en serio!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: Hay criminales en tu cuadrante, con ellos va el Maldito de la masacre de Torann, están infiltr-
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: ¡¡¡Dios mío, Z, ya lo he pillado!!! ¡¡¡No paras de ladrar, ladrar, ladrar, LADRAR!!! ¡¡¡Déjame espacio para pensar!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.dst: ¡¡¡¡Bla bla criminales, bla bla maldito!!!! ¡Sí, ya sé lo importante que es! Flowers, sujétame esto firme, ¿quieres?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: Mientras te centres en las soluciones y no en tus... Pero, Soosu, de ti no he sabido nada. ¡Había datos clave que tuve que averiguar de pasada!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#470.dst: Uno de tus comandantes me resumió el tema. ¡Debería haberlo oído de ti! Así que...¿cuál es tu ángulo? Parece que ignoras el problema.
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.dst: ...¿Soosu? Soosu, ¿me escuchas? ¡Te he hecho una pregunta!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: ¿Hm? Sí, sí, claro. Oye, ¿me traes unos pernos?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.dst: ...vale, de acuerdo- Pero por favor, tenemos que redondear esto, Soosu. Tienes que implicarte.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: Ah, sí, sobre Flowers. ¿Puedes mirar si su cuerpo ha recogido al andar alguna pieza que me sirva?
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: Sabía que dejarte trabajar aquí era irracional. ¡Hay una suma de problemas mucho mayor que tus juguetes! ¡Te comportas como una niña, y no lo eres!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: ¡Sé el buen trabajo que puedes hacer si te aplicas! ¡¿Por qué ignoras a una desertora de alto rango y a un Maldito que elevan a potencia la amenaza del otro?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#481.dst: Ay, mirad a Soosu, siempre tan distraída y despistada, siempre ignorando las necesidades de su distrito, siempre encerrada en su laboratorio.
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: ¿A quién le importa el trabajo que hace? ¡¿Los proyectos que le asignan?! ¡¿A quién le importa que ella sepa, que sepa, que SEPA!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.dst: ...¡Hm! Puede que sí seas mejor, Z. ¡¡Si no lo fueras, quizá ahora no estaríamos aquí!!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: Yo... ... ...lo siento, Soosu. Ese...ese no era mi ángulo, no pretendía-
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: ¡Pero lo has hecho! Pásame el engranaje C-{~}, ¿quieres?
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: ...está bien. Solo quiero llegar al final de esta secuencia lo antes posible.
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: Ya somos dos. Estoy en ello. ¡¡Puedes dejar de darme la lata!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: ...quizá debería haber prestado más atención. No me di cuenta de que su proyecto te cargaba tanto los hombros. Y encima prometí ayudar...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: Los resultados preliminares indican un aprovechamiento de la energía mucho mejor y menos contaminación. (¿Aire más limpio? Puede ayudar.)

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#491.dst: Vuelve a la Pluma de Acero por el túnel de Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#493.dst: ¡Y- y- yo qué sé! ¿Una visita sorpresa? No... no pensé...
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: Así que, "desahogarse", ¡¿eh?! ¡¡Ah, claro, y de paso te traes al Soberano Zhiraok!! ¡¡¡Por qué no!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: ¡Casi nos pillan! Nos- dios, casi... casi nos pillan...
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: ...¿qué estamos haciendo? ¿Por qué- por qué hemos hecho eso? Ha sido tan...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: ¡¿Me lo preguntas a MÍ?! ¡Sí, Rex, ¿por qué lo hemos hecho?!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: Para. Solo... para un segundo. Necesito... pensar.
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: ...maldita sea. ¡Maldita, maldita, maldita sea! Estúpida, impulsiva... ¡uf!
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#501.dst: No, no... no lo estoy. Lo siento, yo- ya debería saberlo...
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: Da... da igual. Ya no se puede deshacer. Podemos... podemos usarlo como as en la manga. Yusanu, dime por favor que puedes averiguar qué es.
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#503.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#503.dst: Yo... no lo sé. Nunca llegué a trabajar muy de cerca con él, así que... no tengo ni idea de qué es. Si lo estudio, quizá llegue a algo. Pero...
The Price of Ingenuity#503.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: Con eso me vale, supongo. Venga, volvamos. Necesito... encontrar a Mora. Y tú tienes que contarles a todos lo que has estado haciendo.
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#505.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#505.dst: Entre todos decidís que dejar a Flowers en paz es probablemente lo mejor para todos.

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: Estas rejillas están rotas y se cerraron por algo. ¡Seguir adelante será peligroso!

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#507.dst: ...¿entonces esconder lo que hemos hecho hoy no es una opción?
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: ¿Y que nos estalle en la cara más adelante? No, gracias. Vamos.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: En serio, Rex, ¿estás... bien? Creo que nunca te había visto-
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#510.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#510.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#511.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#511.dst: ¡Eh! Vosotros tres, ¡¿dónde demonios habéis estado todo el día?!
The Price of Ingenuity#511.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: ¡Sí, es bastante curioso! Da la casualidad de que hablé con Syndra y, por lo visto, ¡no os asignó ninguna de esas "tareas importantes"! ¡Parecía no saber nada del asunto!
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: Sabes lo que ha pasado, Mora. La- la he liado. Otra vez.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: Ah, Yuman, ¿te importaría llevarte a Yusanu para decirles a los demás que llegaremos un poco tarde a la reunión? Creo que hoy habrá alguna noticia más.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: Eh... claro, supongo. Yus, ¿me cuentas qué pasa mientras andamos?
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Es... malo. Robamos algo importante del taller de la Soberana. Es... una larga historia. Yusanu debería contar su parte. Pero...
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: Entiendo. Lo siento, Rex, debería haber estado más atento.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: ¡No! No, no es culpa tuya, debería haber- debería haber visto que estaba siendo impulsiva, yo... no pensaba con claridad.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Ah. Claro, tú no lo sabes. Debí informarte la última vez que ocurrió...
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: Rex tiene a veces estos... ah, "arrebatos", en los que se pone... demasiado exaltada e impulsiva. Más de una vez la han metido en problemas.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#526.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#526.dst: ¡Uf, ya debería saberlo! Sobre todo aquí, sobre todo ahora, cuando...
The Price of Ingenuity#526.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: Bueno, lo hecho, hecho está, y aun así debemos seguir adelante. Vayamos con los demás a la reunión. Syndra tiene algo importante que contarnos.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: Asiste a la reunión en la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: Syndra, creo que eso puede esperar. Ya, ah, hemos retrasado bastante la cena. Si estamos todos, deberíamos empezar. Primero- Yusanu, ¿qué era lo que tenías que contarnos?
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: ...suspiro. Antes de empezar, quiero dejarlo claro- hacía lo que creía mejor para la Pluma de Acero.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: Ya, tío, buen comienzo... da mucha confianza.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: Yuman, por favor... déjame terminar. No me interrumpas.
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#534.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#534.dst: Así que. Así que, así que,así que... La... la razón de que la Corona nos haya dejado en paz aquí abajo es que he estado trabajando con la Soberana Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#534.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: La razón de que hayamos pasado desapercibidos tanto tiempo es esta, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: La razón de que podamos vivir aquí, salir de casa, usar la electricidad de la ciudad... es mi colaboración.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#539.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.dst: Dijo que veía potencial en mí. Me dijo que si la ayudaba en sus talleres, entonces... entonces todos vosotros estaríais a salvo aquí abajo.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: No se lo dije a nadie porque sabía que no lo entenderíais. Pensaríais que era estúpido, arriesgado y mala idea. Trabajar con... con alguien responsable de nuestros problemas.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.dst: Y sabía que era arriesgado. Lo sabía. Pero pensé que si metía la pata, solo me castigarían a mí. Vosotros estaríais a salvo.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: ...veamos. Entiendo que los ánimos están muy alterados ahora mismo. Pediría a todos que den un paso atrás, lo piensen con lógica y mantengan la cal-
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: ¡¿Estás loco, Yusanu?! De todos los secretos que podías guardar-
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: ¡No, creo que no! ¿Por eso eran las alarmas? ¿Cuánto tiempo lleva esto? ¿Qué se te pasaba por la cabeza cuando decidiste-
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: ¡Como si tú no llevaras haciendo lo mismo todo este tiempo! ¡¡Cargándotelo todo a los hombros, sin dejar que nadie te ayude!!
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.dst: Así que- así que, ¿sabes?, estoy un poco enfadado. ¡Debería habérnoslo contado! Pero... nos lo cuenta ahora. Ahora pide ayuda.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: Después del encontronazo de ayer con los soldados... Soosu exige que entregue al responsable. Yo... no puedo hacerlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: Rex y {u} me pillaron hoy hablando con ella. Por eso... por eso os lo cuento.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: ...sí. Le convencí de dejar de trabajar con ella y de contároslo todo.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: También... robamos un aparato importante en el que trabajaban ella y Yusanu. Algo en lo que la Reina tenía mucho interés.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: No sé qué es ni qué hace. No sé para qué sirve. Solo sé que la Reina necesita que se termine. Es lo único en lo que ha tenido a Soosu trabajando... durante meses.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Intentaré averiguar qué es en mis ratos libres. ¡Quizá nos ayude! Yo... espero que sí.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: Yulie, Yuman... os debo una disculpa mejor. Puedo hablar con vosotros en privado luego, pero... ahora deberíamos seguir con la reunión.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: ...desde luego ha sido mucho. Por suerte, enfadar a la Soberana puede acabar dando igual. Si todo sale según lo previsto... la Corona caerá al final del festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: Mi objetivo, como siempre, ha sido encontrar la forma de destruir la influencia de la Corona y liberar nuestra provincia. Creo que este festival es la oportunidad de hacerlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: Durante el Festival de la Corona, Su Majestad morirá.
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: ¡Calma, todos, calma! Por favor, dejad que Syndra continúe.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#563.dst: No será fácil. Pero si atacamos cuando baje la guardia y la cogemos por sorpresa, creo que es posible.
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: Os dividiré en varios grupos y os asignaré tareas que hay que completar antes del festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.dst: La decisión a la que hemos llegado Quill y yo es que iré yo sola a matarla. Así, si algo sale mal... nadie más afronta las consecuencias.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: Mañana repasaré los detalles. Creo que... hoy ya hemos tenido bastante emoción. Por favor, guardad también vuestras quejas hasta entonces.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: Ejem. Sí, desde luego. Supongo que también deberíamos ir a cenar.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: Yuman... quizá sea injusto pedírtelo, pero ¿te importaría tocarnos una canción esta noche? No nos quedan muchos días juntos.
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: Sí... sí, tío, claro. Puedo hacerlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: ¡Entonces disfrutemos de la compañía que nos queda!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: Mira la actuación de Yuman en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: ¡Hola a todos! Tío, eh... poco público hoy, ¿eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: ¡Oh, tío! ¿Ese es Jiro? ¡Eh, tío! No, eh... no esperaba verte.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#575.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.dst: Eh, es que no parecías muy contento conmigo después de... después de ayer. Con lo de- los soldados.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: ... ¡Oh! Ya. No pasa nada. Agua pasada.
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#577.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.dst: Si... ¡si tú lo dices! Creo que esta no la has oído, ¡así que dime qué te parece!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: Pero primero... Yus. Yusanu. Mira, yo... no soy rencoroso. ¡Así que no necesito más disculpas tuyas! Lo entiendo.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: Solo... quiero que confíes más en nosotros, ¿vale? ¡Tú y Yulie, jaja! Porque... ¡yo quiero ayudar!
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: Le he dado vueltas, y sí. Es una faena que no nos lo contaras. Pero tu trato con Soosu- ¡nos salvó! ¡Nos dio un hogar, nos dio un futuro!
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: Así que... esta canción va dedicada a ti. Espero que te guste.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: No... no no no no, ¿dónde está? ¡¿DÓNDE ESTÁ?! Tengo que encontrarlo, yo-
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#584.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#584.dst: ¡IIP! S- Su Majestad, n- n- no la esperaba hasta... mañana. ¿Q- qué hace aquí?
The Price of Ingenuity#584.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#585.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#585.dst: Se me ha liberado la agenda y he decidido venir antes. ¿Ocurre algo, Soberana?
The Price of Ingenuity#585.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#587.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.dst: No te molestes. ¡¿Cómo de incompetente hay que ser para perderlo en tu propio taller?!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#588.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#588.dst: N- n- no entiendo cómo, ¡a mis gólems no los ha tocado nadie! ¡No detectaron nada!
The Price of Ingenuity#588.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#589.dst: Quizá, si te centraras más en la eficiencia en vez de jugar con tus juguetes, esto se podría haber evitado.
The Price of Ingenuity#589.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#590.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#590.dst: Lo- ¡lo arreglaré, lo prometo! ¡Lo prometo lo prometo lo prometo, puedo arreglarlo! ¡Puedo... puedo empezar de nuevo! Tengo todas las notas, y yo-
The Price of Ingenuity#590.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#591.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.dst: Basta. He sido indulgente con tu gestión del distrito porque confiaba en que habría resultados.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#592.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#592.dst: Reiniciar el proyecto del Tejedor de Resonancia... no se puede. Ese artefacto que te confié... esa magia es un arte perdido. No se puede replicar.
The Price of Ingenuity#592.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#593.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#593.dst: N- no, tengo las notas, s- sé cómo funciona, puedo hacerlo, solo- ¡solo deme una oportunidad! ¡Puedo arreglarlo!
The Price of Ingenuity#593.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#594.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#594.dst: Debo prepararme para el festival. Espero tu presencia allí, como siempre. Por favor... aséate antes.
The Price of Ingenuity#594.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#597.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#597.dst: Considera nuestro acuerdo nulo. Me has fallado. Seguirás sirviendo como Soberana indefinidamente... con tu bendición intacta.
The Price of Ingenuity#597.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#598.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.dst: ...¿qué? No- no, no no no, ¡¡¡¡no puedes, no puedes, no puedes!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.speaker: Sovereign Soosu
